name: @nublox/metaobject-storage-mysql
description: Release-qualified MySQL StorageAdapter, MetadataStore, safe query pushdown and versioned schema migrations for @nublox/metaobject, powered by NuBloxSQL.
author: Stephen J T Spittal

scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test test/unit.test.mjs test/query-compiler.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test test/mysql-conformance.test.mjs test/mysql-migrations.test.mjs test/mysql-identity.test.mjs
scripts.test:live: npm run test:integration && npm run test:certification
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run verify:package
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run verify:consumer
scripts.release:check:live: npm run release:check && npm run test:live
